text: Delivery Operations wants to know: of all parcels due by noon, how many arrived on time?
say: Delivery Operations wants to know: of all parcels due by noon, how many arrived on time?

text: At one o’clock, two parcels arrived on time, one arrived late, and one is unfinished. All four were due by noon. Assume these records are complete.
say: At one o’clock, two parcels arrived on time, one arrived late, and one is unfinished. All four were due by noon. Assume these records are complete.

text: First, ask about completed deliveries. The late parcel belongs because it arrived. The unfinished parcel stays outside this group. Two on time out of three completed gives sixty-six point seven percent.

text: All four were due, including the unfinished parcel. The numerator stays at two. Two out of four gives fifty percent.

text: Try a separate example with complete records: six parcels due, two on time, two late and two unfinished. What percentage of all parcels due arrived on time? Pause before continuing.
